We had an excellent experience at this clinic. Yesterday we went to a different clinic that really felt like they were trying to profit from us, which made us lose trust in their advice. Because of that, we decided to come here instead — and we’re so glad we did.

The staff at this clinic were genuinely helpful and caring, even on a Sunday. The doctor wasn’t on-site at the time, but they were immediately reachable by phone. We were able to speak with the doctor directly, and thanks to that call it became clear that we only needed one shot. They helped us right away and everything felt transparent, honest, and reassuring.

We’re very grateful for the support we received. If you need a rabies vaccination, this is definitely a place we would recommend.

From first impression the place looks very clean and welcoming, the staff are amazing and also very welcoming. I came to get a vaccination and they made sure I was well looked after. I definitely recommend this place for anyone who is looking to get a vaccine or any sort of treatment. Thank you to all the staff for being so kind and lovely!

Excellent service at Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic. I went for my second Hepatitis B injection and the staff were really helpful and kind. I just walked in and was able to be seen the same day. Thanks to all at the clinic 😊 …

My friend and I got blood tests and our vaccinations for our travels through South East Asia here, the team was so helpful in recommending the right vaccines to get. The doctor was away but even took the time to give us a call and answer any questions we had. The nurses who did our procedures were attentive, gentle and very skilled. The injections were painless, the blood tests were done smoothly and easily, (no poking around for a vein!) and they were able to calm any nervousness we had. The place was very clean and the room was comfortable. The team made sure to keep an eye on us afterwards to ensure there were no reactions after the injections. To anyone coming to Chang Mai in need of medical care I would wholeheartedly recommend this place! Thank you so much everyone!

Unfortunately, my Botox experience was not the greatest.
I asked for a very light Botox, or what they call now baby Botox, and they were very pushy to make me buy more units when I know what I need.

I saw a comment saying they did it too low and someone’s eyebrows were falling too much; oh gosh I should have listened to that. I went there and specifically requested for them to not do it too low; they did. I never had my eyebrow falling so much over my eyes. Terrible result. I look ridiculous.

On top of that, the « doctor » I saw was far form nice and seemed very haughty.

Update : not taking any accountability, they contacted me to say my eyebrows were exactly in the same position before. (Meaning : you’re lying. Oh my)
It’s a common side effect of Botox is not injected high enough, and depending on facial feature. With mine, you have to be careful to not put it too low.

Update 21/02 : so about 10 days later, my eyebrows have been falling so much I’m getting a double crease and it’s ruining my face. I can’t even look something else than sleepy and weird.

You ruined my face.

Fantastic service! Highly recommend. Clinic was undergoing construction in front with a banner fuly covering it, so I couldn't see any entrance. When I called, a lovely woman came out to guide me inside.

Very clean, spacious, excellent doctor and informed on travel information. Very kind and incredible bedside manner. Cozy post-vaccine room with sofas, blankets and an olive tree. Ingot the JE vaccine, $1000 THB with consultation. Smiling and friendly staff. I will definitely return if I come back next year!

text: The level of care at this clinic is unmatched compared to anything I’ve received in America. Everyone of the staff is so kind and friendly and knowledgeable it makes it very easy to trust them with your health. Couldn’t recommend this place more.

I had the most amazing experience at Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic and cannot say enough wonderful things about the care I received from Dr. Nicha (Dr. Tan) and the entire team.

From the moment my partner and I arrived, we were made to feel completely comfortable and at ease. The consultation process was thoughtful, thorough, and truly patient-centred, with zero pressure at any point. Dr. Tan took the time to explain everything clearly and made sure I felt confident and relaxed before proceeding with my treatment.

A very special thank you to Bubbib, who gently applied the numbing cream and made me feel so well cared for, and to Fon, who applied the soothing jelly mask, followed by Pipo, who removed it with such care and kindness. Every step of the process felt calm, professional, and genuinely warm.

I had the Ultraformer III procedure, and the results are honestly incredible — some of the best I’ve seen in all my years of facial rejuvenation treatments. The lifting, tightening, and overall improvement are remarkable, and the experience itself was smooth and far more comfortable than I expected.

The pricing was also extremely reasonable for the level of expertise, technology, and care provided. It’s rare to find a clinic that combines medical professionalism, kindness, transparency, and outstanding results so seamlessly.

I highly recommend Dr. Tan and the entire Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic team to anyone looking for safe, high-quality aesthetic treatments in Chiang Mai. This clinic is truly a gem.

I came for my rabies vaccination here and had a great experience. The ladies here were all so kind and welcoming. The vaccine was also the most affordable in the area whilst the clinic also seems the cleanest and nicest! Would definitely recommend. Thank you ☺️

Edit:  Coming back in January 2026!!
I absolutely love "I know a place" and that I'd highly recommend it to others.

🪷 After hours of research by my husband, we chose Chiang Mai Wellness Clinic for some rejuvenation of my 55-year old skin. They told me it would probably be 2 or 3 months until I saw full results, which it was, but saw instant gratification that week. Who wouldn't be cautious having a facial procedure in a foreign country? Honestly, the entire process from research to results was extremely professional, comfortable, sterile and actually quite charming. This was a great birthday present to myself and I highly recommend this business.
Before & After photos. No filter just different lighting.

I very unhappy with the botox that I received in my forehead as it caused me to have eyebrow droop. The doctor was inexperienced and did not assess the anatomy of my face properly so the dose he gave me was too high and injected too low. I was not asked how I wanted my forehead to look, he just told me the dose I needed and as it was my first time getting it, I presumed he knew what he was doing.

I have been to see a doctor back in the UK who looked at the size of my forehead and the anatomy of my face and immediately said I was given too high a dose and that it should have been injected higher up. My whole forehead is frozen, I can not lift my eyebrows at all, therefore he could not do a corrective treatment as it would not work or could end up worse. I was glad to have found someone who was honest and explained everything with great detail.

I now have to wait until the botox wears off for it to be resolved. I have had lots of headaches since and it has caused me a lot of stress. I contacted the clinic after and they said it will be better after 2 weeks which it isn't. I messaged them again to let them know and haven't had a reply.

Do not go here for botx! Please find a reputable doctor with plenty of experience, do your research and choose  wisely.

Went here for flu vaccination. Arrived 20 minutes early and no problem, they saw me straight away. Filled in a short consent form with my details and had the vaccination performed by a nurse after answering some questions by a Doctor. Clean modern clinic over 4 levels. At the time of writing, the facades of the building was undergoing renovations. Upon arriving by vehicle turn left after parking then sharp left again. I couldn't see how to get in on arriving but rang the clinic and staff member came out within a few seconds to show me the entrance way. Reasonable prices and appear to know what they're doing. They cover a lot of things including HPV vaccination, skincare services etc.

I visited the clinic March 12th & loved every second I was there. I did not have an appointment I merely showed up with intentions of getting botox where my frown lines were making a permanent indention. I filled out paper work, was asked …

The initial experience was fine, but 2 weeks after I noticed that two holes developed after they injected me a solution for my acne. (This should not happen if the injector is experienced or certified, at least that’s why the plastic surgeon who fixed their mistakes told me) They never showed me what exactly they were injecting, just came with a tray of syringes, it should have been enough as a red flag but because of so many good reviews I trusted.. now I believe most of them are fake..  plus was not cheap to begin with..

Had to spend a lot of money to correct their mistakes.. avoid it!!

Got the TdaP vaccine booster shot here. Everything went smooth and fast, personell were very nice and friendly.

Visit date: 22 Oct 2025

The worst tattoo removal experience ever, I’ve had tattoo removal done in many places in the world and normally for the three tattoos I’ve been having removed for over a year removal takes around 15 minutes but at this place yesterday it took almost 2 hours!!!

Also, the laser machine is either very bad at removing tattoos and/or the therapist didn’t use the most ideal effective settings, because the whole time the tattoos were being lasered there was almost no pain (I didn’t use topical anesthesia) which means the laser wasn’t targeting the ink to break it down and twice she lasered two parts of another tattoo I didn’t want removing and now it’s removed some of its ink and I have to go and pay a tattoo artist to fill in the removed parts!!

In the photos attached you can see the tattoos the day after they tried to remove them and the hands don’t look lasered at all, the wrist looks slightly lasered but normally from other laser clinics I would have really big swelling and lots of signs of the removal working correctly, feels like I got ripped off and paid for nothing.

In all very unprofessional, ruined a part of one of my other tattoos, I WARN YOU NEVER COME HERE FOR TATTOO REMOVAL!

I had an appointment in January 2026 for lip injections. It was my first injection, so I expected more precision from the doctor; it was mostly up to me to say what I wanted (something natural and well done, obviously), and she didn't ask any questions, which was quite awkward.

I opted for the Neuramis product, and the doctor assured me that it would last at least 6 months.

Spoiler alert: it only lasted 2 months.

The lumps never went away.

Today, the product has dissolved, even though I followed all the instructions (avoiding caffeine and spicy foods, staying well-hydrated, etc.), but I still have the lump in my lower lip.
